PluginData.Author: Viktor
PluginData.Tooltip: Test only: the dedicated server loads world mods from its Mods folder
PluginData.Description: Test only. A dedicated server running without Steam (DirectTransport) cannot query or download Workshop items, so a modded world fails to load. With this plugin the server takes each world mod from Mods/<PublishedFileId>.sbm in its data folder and downloads nothing.
